name: Potion of Invisibility

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Invisible for 1 hour, or until you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.
text: The bottle seems empty, yet you can feel liquid sloshing inside. Drinking it, you gain the Invisible condition for up to 1 hour; it ends early the moment you cast a spell, make an attack roll or deal damage.
